_about: Kept by hand. Deep-merged over what scripts/open5e/setup.mjs parses from Open5e, by ruleset, section and name; arrays replace. Choices: kind is skill, expertise, tool, language, ability, proficiency (skill or tool), feat, option, spell (spell: level and class list) or casting (the spellcasting ability for granted spells); from is a list, "any", "proficient", "options" or "spells". fixedBy "parenthetical" lets a feat's name answer an option choice (Magic Initiate (Cleric)). Grants may give spells ([[name, character level]]) and their casting ability. typos are words Open5e misspells, corrected in every name and text. A class's featureExtras give its features, by name, uses and actions. Uses: recharge (rechargeByLevel changes it from a level), and max, byLevel ([[level, max]]), perLevel (times the level), perProf, or ability (its modifier, plus bonus). extraChoices are added to an entry's parsed choices. Actions may carry scale ([[level, dice]]), dieScale ([[level, die]]) and flatLevel (the level added to the damage).

actions.name: Divine Smite
actions.desc: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal 2d8 radiant damage, plus 1d8 for each slot level above 1st (at most 5d8), and 1d8 more against an undead or a fiend.

actions.name: Sneak Attack
actions.range: Once per turn, on a hit
actions.desc: Once per turn, deal the extra damage to one creature you hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon attack if you have Advantage on the roll, or if an ally of yours is within 5 feet of the target and you don't have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Second Wind
actions.desc: As a bonus action, regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once used, you must finish a short or long rest before using it again.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Martial Arts)
actions.desc: Your unarmed strikes use your Martial Arts die and your Dexterity. You can make one as a Bonus Action after the Attack action.

options.name: Black dragon
options.desc: Acid damage. Breath weapon: 5 by 30 ft. line (DEX save). Resistance to acid damage.

features.name: Draconic Ancestry: Black
features.desc: Your breath weapon deals acid damage in a 5 by 30 ft. line (Dexterity save), and you have resistance to acid damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon
actions.desc: Each creature in the 5 by 30 ft. line makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus), taking acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th and 5d6 at 16th. Once used, it can't be used again until you finish a short or long rest.

options.name: High Elf

options.desc: The Minor Illusion cantrip, and Speak with Animals prepared, castable without a slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

options.name: Rock Gnome
options.desc: The Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips, and you can make Tiny clockwork devices with Prestidigitation.

options.name: Cloud's Jaunt (Cloud Giant)
options.desc: As a Bonus Action, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

options.name: Fire's Burn (Fire Giant)
options.desc: When you hit with an attack roll and deal damage, also deal 1d10 Fire damage.

options.name: Frost's Chill (Frost Giant)
options.desc: When you hit with an attack roll and deal damage, also deal 1d6 Cold damage and reduce the target's Speed by 10 feet.

options.name: Hill's Tumble (Hill Giant)
options.desc: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage, you can give it the Prone condition.

options.name: Stone's Endurance (Stone Giant)
options.desc: As a Reaction when you take damage, roll 1d12, add your Constitution modifier and reduce the damage by that total.

options.name: Storm's Thunder (Storm Giant)
options.desc: As a Reaction when a creature within 60 feet damages you, deal it 1d8 Thunder damage.

options.name: Abyssal
options.desc: Resistance to Poison damage and the Poison Spray cantrip; Ray of Sickness at level 3 and Hold Person at level 5.

options.name: Chthonic
options.desc: Resistance to Necrotic damage and the Chill Touch cantrip; False Life at level 3 and Ray of Enfeeblement at level 5.

options.name: Infernal
options.desc: Resistance to Fire damage and the Fire Bolt cantrip; Hellish Rebuke at level 3 and Darkness at level 5.

options.name: Cleric
options.desc: Two Cleric cantrips and one level 1 Cleric spell.

options.name: Druid
